description: This PHP class defines a client for Amazon DeviceFarm service, including method signatures for various API operations and their async equivalents. It extends a generic AWS client class and provides a set of callable methods for interacting with the DeviceFarm API.

classes.name: DeviceFarmClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with Amazon DeviceFarm service, providing methods for resource management, test execution, and remote device interactions.

methods.name: createDevicePool
methods.description: Creates a new device pool in Amazon DeviceFarm.

methods.name: createDevicePoolAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new device pool, returning a promise.

methods.name: deleteDevicePoolAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a device pool, returning a promise.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific device.

methods.name: getDeviceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves device information, returning a promise.
